{
  "file_path": "C:\\dev\\CashRegister\\tests\\CashRegister.Tests\\Features\\Change\\Strategies\\MinimalChangeStrategyTests.cs",
  "content": "using CashRegister.Features.Change.Money;\nusing CashRegister.Features.Change.Strategies;\nusing CashRegister.Features.Currencies;\n\nnamespace CashRegister.Tests.Features.Change.Strategies;\n\npublic sealed class MinimalChangeStrategyTests\n{\n    private static readonly UsdCurrency Usd = new();\n    private readonly MinimalChangeStrategy _strategy = new();\n\n    private static IEnumerable<(string Name, long Count)> Describe(IReadOnlyList<ChangeLine> lines) =>\n        lines.Select(l => (l.Denomination.SingularName, l.Count));\n\n    [Fact]\n    [Trait(\"AC\", \"AC-003\")]\n    public void MakeChange_88Cents_Is3Quarters1Dime3Pennies()\n    {\n        var lines = _strategy.MakeChange(88, Usd);\n\n        Describe(lines).ShouldBe([(\"quarter\", 3L), (\"dime\", 1L), (\"penny\", 3L)]);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    [Trait(\"AC\", \"AC-003\")]\n    public void MakeChange_3Cents_Is3Pennies()\n    {\n        Describe(_strategy.MakeChange(3, Usd)).ShouldBe([(\"penny\", 3L)]);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    [Trait(\"AC\", \"AC-003\")]\n    public void MakeChange_167Cents_Is1Dollar2Quarters1Dime1Nickel2Pennies()\n    {\n        Describe(_strategy.MakeChange(167, Usd))\n            .ShouldBe([(\"dollar\", 1L), (\"quarter\", 2L), (\"dime\", 1L), (\"nickel\", 1L), (\"penny\", 2L)]);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void MakeChange_Zero_IsEmpty()\n    {\n        _strategy.MakeChange(0, Usd).ShouldBeEmpty();\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    [Trait(\"AC\", \"AC-005\")]\n    public void MakeChange_AnyAmountUpTo1000Cents_SumsExactlyToAmount()\n    {\n        for (long amount = 0; amount <= 1000; amount++)\n        {\n            _strategy.MakeChange(amount, Usd).Sum(l => l.Total).ShouldBe(amount, $\"amount {amount}\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void MakeChange_NegativeAmount_Throws()\n    {\n        Should.Throw<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() => _strategy.MakeChange(-1, Usd));\n    }\n}\n"
}
```

  "content": "using CashRegister.Features.Change.Money;\nusing CashRegister.Features.Currencies;\n\nnamespace CashRegister.Features.Change.Strategies;\n\n/// <summary>\n/// Minimum physical change: take as many of each denomination as fit, largest first.\n/// This greedy approach is optimal for canonical coin systems such as USD (AC-003).\n/// </summary>\npublic sealed class MinimalChangeStrategy : IChangeStrategy\n{\n    public IReadOnlyList<ChangeLine> MakeChange(long amount, Currency currency)\n    {\n        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfNegative(amount);\n        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(currency);\n\n        var lines = new List<ChangeLine>();\n        var remaining = amount;\n\n        foreach (var denomination in currency.Denominations)\n        {\n            var count = remaining / denomination.ValueInMinorUnits;\n            if (count == 0)\n            {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            var line = new ChangeLine(denomination, count);\n            lines.Add(line);\n            remaining -= line.Total;\n        }\n\n        return lines;\n    }\n}\n"
}

## Assistant · 2026-09-21T17:33:50.625Z

T-003 is done. `Transaction` and the fewest-coins method are in place, and all 34 tests pass (33 unit, 1 integration).

- **`Transaction`:** holds the owed and paid amounts in cents, rejects negative amounts or paid less than owed, and works out the change due (AC-005).
- **`ChangeLine`:** one denomination and its count, e.g. 3 quarters.
- **`MinimalChangeStrategy`:** takes as many of the largest coin as fit, then moves down (AC-003). Tests check 88¢ → 3 quarters, 1 dime, 3 pennies; 3¢ → 3 pennies; and 167¢. Another test confirms the coins add up exactly for every amount from 0 to 1000¢.
- **Gates:** format check clean, Release build with 0 warnings, 100% line and branch coverage on the three new classes.

Two small notes:
- The stubs had to read instance data, because the analyzer rule CA1822 fails the build otherwise.
- The permissions blocked `rm -rf` on the coverage folder. I didn't need it, since each run overwrites the coverage file.

Commit message:
```
feat(change): add Transaction, ChangeLine and minimal change strategy (T-003)
```

# /net-build

**Phase:** 4 — build (TDD)
**Owning agent:** `.claude/agents/dotnet-implementer.md` (collaborates with `dotnet-test-engineer`)
**Skills used:** `tdd-red-green-refactor`, `dotnet-10-conventions`, `clarity-over-cleverness`, `dotnet-testing-patterns`, `dotnet-task-decomposition`

## Purpose
Execute one task end-to-end through the four TDD phases (red → green → refactor → simplify), updating `.tdd-state.json` and appending a block to `05-implementation-log.md` after each phase.

## Inputs
- `<task-id>` (e.g. `T-001`). Required.

## Reads
- `.specs/<feature-id>/04-tasks.md`
- `.specs/<feature-id>/03-design.md`
- `.specs/<feature-id>/.tdd-state.json`
- `.claude/skills/tdd-red-green-refactor/SKILL.md` (authoritative)
- `.claude/skills/dotnet-testing-patterns/SKILL.md` (scope selection and the `[Trait("AC", ...)]` contract)

## Writes
- `tests/<Module>.Tests/**`, `tests/<Module>.IntegrationTests/**` and `src/<Module>/Features/<Slice>/**` files listed in `tasks[<task-id>].files_in_scope`.
- `.specs/<feature-id>/.tdd-state.json` (phase transitions; `tasks` is a map keyed by task id with a top-level `active_task`).
- `.specs/<feature-id>/05-implementation-log.md` (one `### <task-id> — <phase>` block per phase).

## Process
For the supplied `<task-id>`:

0. **Pre-flight commit check.** Run `git status`. If there are uncommitted changes from any prior task, refuse to start. List the changed files and remind: `git commit → /net-build <task-id>`.
1. **Activate.** Set `.tdd-state.json` `active_task = <task-id>`. Refuse if any other task is `phase: red|green|refactor|simplify` (one task in flight at a time).
2. **Red** (`dotnet-test-engineer`). Write the smallest test that captures the next AC slice, with the attribute block in order: `[Fact]`/`[Theory]` → `[Trait("AC", "AC-NNN")]` → `[Trait("Category", "Integration")]` when it needs a container or the full host. Run it with `dotnet test --filter "FullyQualifiedName~ClassName.MethodName"`. Confirm it fails on an assertion, not a compile error. Capture the failure message into `tasks[<task-id>].red_failure_excerpt`. Set `phase: "red"`. Append log block.
3. **Green** (`dotnet-implementer`). Write the minimum production code under `files_in_scope` to pass the test. Re-run the single test, then `dotnet test --filter "Category!=Integration"` for the unit suite (plus `dotnet test --filter "Category=Integration"` when integration files were touched). Set `phase: "green"`. Append log block.
4. **Refactor.** Improve structure without changing behavior or public signatures. Re-run the suite after every edit. Set `phase: "refactor"`. Append log block.
5. **Simplify.** Apply `clarity-over-cleverness` (untangle ternaries, inline once-used helpers, kill dead options, name domain concepts from the `01-spec.md` glossary, extract every literal that appears 2+ times in a file). Run `dotnet format --verify-no-changes` and `dotnet build -c Release` (warning-free) plus the suite. Set `phase: "simplify"`. Append log block.
6. **Done.** Set `phase: "done"`, clear `active_task`. If more ACs in this task remain uncovered, immediately re-run from step 2 with the next slice (do not declare done early).
7. **STOP — commit reminder.** Surface: files changed (`git status`), tests passing, suggested commit message. Recommend: `git status → git commit → /net-build <next-task-id>`. Do not auto-start the next task unless the user explicitly requests chaining.

## Refuse if
- `<task-id>` is not in `.tdd-state.json`, or `.tdd-state.json` has an array-shaped `tasks` value (the hooks reject it — re-run `/net-plan`).
- Another task is mid-flight (not `pending` or `done`).
- A `src/**/*.cs` edit is attempted while `phase != "red"` and `red_failure_excerpt` is empty (also enforced by the Claude hook `block-impl-without-failing-test.sh`).
- Any edit lands outside `tasks[<task-id>].files_in_scope` (enforced by `enforce-files-in-scope.sh`).
- A skip or gate-weakening flag would be needed — `dotnet test --no-build`, `-p:SkipTests`, `-p:RunAnalyzers=false`, `-p:TreatWarningsAsErrors=false` (enforced by `forbid-skip-flags.sh`).
- The spec or design leaves the edge case undefined — halt and open a `Q-NNN` instead of choosing a silent default (`block-progress-on-open-questions.sh`).
- A new NuGet package would be needed and the user has not confirmed it (version goes in `Directory.Packages.props`, never inline on the `PackageReference`).

## Done when
- Every AC listed under `tasks[<task-id>].acs_covered` has at least one test carrying `[Trait("AC", "AC-NNN")]`.
- All four phase blocks are present in `05-implementation-log.md` for this task.
- `.tdd-state.json` shows `phase: "done"` for `<task-id>` and `active_task` is cleared.
- `dotnet format --verify-no-changes` is clean and `dotnet build -c Release` produces no warnings.
- Commit reminder surfaced (Step 7); user commits before starting the next task. After all tasks done, run `/net-test` then `/net-validate`.

  "file_path": "C:\\dev\\CashRegister\\tests\\CashRegister.Tests\\Features\\Change\\Strategies\\RandomChangeStrategyTests.cs",
  "content": "using CashRegister.Features.Change.Money;\nusing CashRegister.Features.Change.Strategies;\nusing CashRegister.Features.Currencies;\n\nnamespace CashRegister.Tests.Features.Change.Strategies;\n\npublic sealed class RandomChangeStrategyTests\n{\n    private static readonly UsdCurrency Usd = new();\n\n    private static IReadOnlyList<ChangeLine> MakeChange(int seed, long amount) =>\n        new RandomChangeStrategy(new Random(seed)).MakeChange(amount, Usd);\n\n    private static string Describe(IReadOnlyList<ChangeLine> lines) =>\n        string.Join(\",\", lines.Select(l => $\"{l.Count} {l.Denomination.SingularName}\"));\n\n    [Fact]\n    [Trait(\"AC\", \"AC-005\")]\n    public void MakeChange_ManySeedsAndAmounts_AlwaysSumsExactlyToAmount()\n    {\n        for (var seed = 0; seed < 1000; seed++)\n        {\n            var amount = seed % 501;\n            MakeChange(seed, amount).Sum(l => l.Total).ShouldBe(amount, $\"seed {seed}, amount {amount}\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void MakeChange_SameSeed_GivesSameResult()\n    {\n        Describe(MakeChange(seed: 42, amount: 167)).ShouldBe(Describe(MakeChange(seed: 42, amount: 167)));\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    [Trait(\"AC\", \"AC-004\")]\n    public void MakeChange_DifferentSeeds_ProduceDifferentDenominations()\n    {\n        var distinctResults = Enumerable.Range(0, 20)\n            .Select(seed => Describe(MakeChange(seed, 167)))\n            .Distinct()\n            .Count();\n\n        distinctResults.ShouldBeGreaterThan(1);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    [Trait(\"AC\", \"AC-007\")]\n    public void MakeChange_LinesAreLargestFirstWithoutZeroCounts()\n    {\n        for (var seed = 0; seed < 200; seed++)\n        {\n            var lines = MakeChange(seed, 467);\n\n            lines.ShouldAllBe(l => l.Count > 0);\n            lines.Select(l => l.Denomination.ValueInMinorUnits).ShouldBeInOrder(SortDirection.Descending);\n        }\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void MakeChange_Zero_IsEmpty()\n    {\n        MakeChange(seed: 1, amount: 0).ShouldBeEmpty();\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void MakeChange_NegativeAmount_Throws()\n    {\n        Should.Throw<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() => MakeChange(seed: 1, amount: -1));\n    }\n}\n"
}

{
  "file_path": "C:\\dev\\CashRegister\\src\\CashRegister\\Features\\Change\\Strategies\\RandomChangeStrategy.cs",
  "content": "using CashRegister.Features.Change.Money;\nusing CashRegister.Features.Currencies;\n\nnamespace CashRegister.Features.Change.Strategies;\n\n/// <summary>\n/// Random change behaviour (AC-004): walking from the largest denomination down, take a\n/// random count of each that still fits. The smallest unit makes up whatever is left, so\n/// the total is always exact (AC-005). The result may happen to be minimal (Q-007).\n/// </summary>\n/// <param name=\"random\">Injected so tests can use a fixed seed (ADR-003).</param>\npublic sealed class RandomChangeStrategy(Random random) : IChangeStrategy\n{\n    private readonly Random _random = random ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(random));\n\n    public IReadOnlyList<ChangeLine> MakeChange(long amount, Currency currency)\n    {\n        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfNegative(amount);\n        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(currency);\n\n        var lines = new List<ChangeLine>();\n        var remaining = amount;\n        var smallest = currency.Denominations[^1];\n\n        foreach (var denomination in currency.Denominations)\n        {\n            var mostThatFit = remaining / denomination.ValueInMinorUnits;\n            var count = denomination == smallest\n                ? mostThatFit\n                : _random.NextInt64(0, mostThatFit + 1);\n\n            if (count == 0)\n            {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            var line = new ChangeLine(denomination, count);\n            lines.Add(line);\n            remaining -= line.Total;\n        }\n\n        return lines;\n    }\n}\n"
}
```

## Assistant · 2026-09-21T17:38:10.014Z

T-004 is done. The random change method works, and all 41 tests pass (40 unit, 1 integration).

**How it works:** it goes from the largest coin down and takes a random number of each coin that still fits. Pennies make up whatever is left, so the coins always add up exactly to the change (AC-005). The random result can happen to match the fewest-coins result, which your Q-007 answer allows. The random generator is passed in, so tests can use a fixed seed and get the same result every time.

**What the tests check**
- The total is exact across 1000 seeds, for amounts from 0 to 500¢.
- Different seeds give different coins for 167¢ (AC-004).
- The same seed always gives the same result.
- Coins are listed largest first, with no zero counts.
- Zero change gives no coins, and a negative amount or a missing random generator is rejected.

**Gates:** format check clean, Release build with 0 warnings. Branch coverage was 87.5% at first, below the 90% floor, because the missing-generator check had no test. I added one, and coverage is now 100% line and branch.

Commit message:
```
feat(change): add random change strategy with injectable Random (T-004)
```

Then run `/net-build T-005` (rules, divisor setting and the calculator).

## User · 2026-09-21T17:40:22.697Z

# /net-build

**Phase:** 4 — build (TDD)
**Owning agent:** `.claude/agents/dotnet-implementer.md` (collaborates with `dotnet-test-engineer`)
**Skills used:** `tdd-red-green-refactor`, `dotnet-10-conventions`, `clarity-over-cleverness`, `dotnet-testing-patterns`, `dotnet-task-decomposition`

## Purpose
Execute one task end-to-end through the four TDD phases (red → green → refactor → simplify), updating `.tdd-state.json` and appending a block to `05-implementation-log.md` after each phase.

## Inputs
- `<task-id>` (e.g. `T-001`). Required.

## Reads
- `.specs/<feature-id>/04-tasks.md`
- `.specs/<feature-id>/03-design.md`
- `.specs/<feature-id>/.tdd-state.json`
- `.claude/skills/tdd-red-green-refactor/SKILL.md` (authoritative)
- `.claude/skills/dotnet-testing-patterns/SKILL.md` (scope selection and the `[Trait("AC", ...)]` contract)

## Writes
- `tests/<Module>.Tests/**`, `tests/<Module>.IntegrationTests/**` and `src/<Module>/Features/<Slice>/**` files listed in `tasks[<task-id>].files_in_scope`.
- `.specs/<feature-id>/.tdd-state.json` (phase transitions; `tasks` is a map keyed by task id with a top-level `active_task`).
- `.specs/<feature-id>/05-implementation-log.md` (one `### <task-id> — <phase>` block per phase).

## Process
For the supplied `<task-id>`:

0. **Pre-flight commit check.** Run `git status`. If there are uncommitted changes from any prior task, refuse to start. List the changed files and remind: `git commit → /net-build <task-id>`.
1. **Activate.** Set `.tdd-state.json` `active_task = <task-id>`. Refuse if any other task is `phase: red|green|refactor|simplify` (one task in flight at a time).
2. **Red** (`dotnet-test-engineer`). Write the smallest test that captures the next AC slice, with the attribute block in order: `[Fact]`/`[Theory]` → `[Trait("AC", "AC-NNN")]` → `[Trait("Category", "Integration")]` when it needs a container or the full host. Run it with `dotnet test --filter "FullyQualifiedName~ClassName.MethodName"`. Confirm it fails on an assertion, not a compile error. Capture the failure message into `tasks[<task-id>].red_failure_excerpt`. Set `phase: "red"`. Append log block.
3. **Green** (`dotnet-implementer`). Write the minimum production code under `files_in_scope` to pass the test. Re-run the single test, then `dotnet test --filter "Category!=Integration"` for the unit suite (plus `dotnet test --filter "Category=Integration"` when integration files were touched). Set `phase: "green"`. Append log block.
4. **Refactor.** Improve structure without changing behavior or public signatures. Re-run the suite after every edit. Set `phase: "refactor"`. Append log block.
5. **Simplify.** Apply `clarity-over-cleverness` (untangle ternaries, inline once-used helpers, kill dead options, name domain concepts from the `01-spec.md` glossary, extract every literal that appears 2+ times in a file). Run `dotnet format --verify-no-changes` and `dotnet build -c Release` (warning-free) plus the suite. Set `phase: "simplify"`. Append log block.
6. **Done.** Set `phase: "done"`, clear `active_task`. If more ACs in this task remain uncovered, immediately re-run from step 2 with the next slice (do not declare done early).
7. **STOP — commit reminder.** Surface: files changed (`git status`), tests passing, suggested commit message. Recommend: `git status → git commit → /net-build <next-task-id>`. Do not auto-start the next task unless the user explicitly requests chaining.

## Refuse if
- `<task-id>` is not in `.tdd-state.json`, or `.tdd-state.json` has an array-shaped `tasks` value (the hooks reject it — re-run `/net-plan`).
- Another task is mid-flight (not `pending` or `done`).
- A `src/**/*.cs` edit is attempted while `phase != "red"` and `red_failure_excerpt` is empty (also enforced by the Claude hook `block-impl-without-failing-test.sh`).
- Any edit lands outside `tasks[<task-id>].files_in_scope` (enforced by `enforce-files-in-scope.sh`).
- A skip or gate-weakening flag would be needed — `dotnet test --no-build`, `-p:SkipTests`, `-p:RunAnalyzers=false`, `-p:TreatWarningsAsErrors=false` (enforced by `forbid-skip-flags.sh`).
- The spec or design leaves the edge case undefined — halt and open a `Q-NNN` instead of choosing a silent default (`block-progress-on-open-questions.sh`).
- A new NuGet package would be needed and the user has not confirmed it (version goes in `Directory.Packages.props`, never inline on the `PackageReference`).

## Done when
- Every AC listed under `tasks[<task-id>].acs_covered` has at least one test carrying `[Trait("AC", "AC-NNN")]`.
- All four phase blocks are present in `05-implementation-log.md` for this task.
- `.tdd-state.json` shows `phase: "done"` for `<task-id>` and `active_task` is cleared.
- `dotnet format --verify-no-changes` is clean and `dotnet build -c Release` produces no warnings.
- Commit reminder surfaced (Step 7); user commits before starting the next task. After all tasks done, run `/net-test` then `/net-validate`.

  "content": "using CashRegister.Features.Change.Rules;\n\nnamespace CashRegister.Tests.Features.Change.Rules;\n\npublic sealed class InMemoryDivisorSettingsTests\n{\n    [Fact]\n    public void Current_Initially_IsThree()\n    {\n        new InMemoryDivisorSettings().Current.ShouldBe(3);\n    }\n\n    [Theory]\n    [Trait(\"AC\", \"AC-025\")]\n    [InlineData(1)]\n    [InlineData(5)]\n    public void Set_PositiveInteger_ChangesCurrent(int divisor)\n    {\n        var settings = new InMemoryDivisorSettings();\n\n        settings.Set(divisor);\n\n        settings.Current.ShouldBe(divisor);\n    }\n\n    [Theory]\n    [InlineData(0)]\n    [InlineData(-2)]\n    public void Set_LessThanOne_ThrowsAndKeepsCurrent(int divisor)\n    {\n        var settings = new InMemoryDivisorSettings();\n\n        Should.Throw<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() => settings.Set(divisor));\n\n        settings.Current.ShouldBe(3);\n    }\n}\n"
}

  "content": "using CashRegister.Features.Change.Money;\nusing CashRegister.Features.Change.Rules;\nusing CashRegister.Features.Change.Strategies;\nusing CashRegister.Features.Currencies;\n\nnamespace CashRegister.Tests.Features.Change.Rules;\n\npublic sealed class OwedDivisibleByRuleTests\n{\n    private static readonly UsdCurrency Usd = new();\n    private readonly InMemoryDivisorSettings _settings = new();\n\n    private bool Matches(long owed) =>\n        new OwedDivisibleByRule(_settings).Matches(new Transaction(owed, paid: owed + 100, Usd));\n\n    [Theory]\n    [Trait(\"AC\", \"AC-004\")]\n    [InlineData(333)]\n    [InlineData(300)]\n    public void Matches_OwedCentsDivisibleByThree_IsTrue(long owed)\n    {\n        Matches(owed).ShouldBeTrue();\n    }\n\n    [Theory]\n    [Trait(\"AC\", \"AC-004\")]\n    [InlineData(212)]\n    [InlineData(197)]\n    public void Matches_OwedCentsNotDivisibleByThree_IsFalse(long owed)\n    {\n        Matches(owed).ShouldBeFalse();\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    [Trait(\"AC\", \"AC-013\")]\n    public void Matches_UsesTheActiveDivisor()\n    {\n        _settings.Set(5);\n\n        Matches(500).ShouldBeTrue();\n        Matches(333).ShouldBeFalse();\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void StrategyType_IsRandomChange()\n    {\n        new OwedDivisibleByRule(_settings).StrategyType.ShouldBe(typeof(RandomChangeStrategy));\n    }\n}\n"
}

  "content": "namespace CashRegister.Features.Change.Rules;\n\n/// <summary>Holds the divisor in process memory; lost on restart (NFR-005, ADR-002).</summary>\npublic sealed class InMemoryDivisorSettings : IDivisorSettings\n{\n    public const int DefaultDivisor = 3;\n    public const int MinimumDivisor = 1;\n\n    private int _current = DefaultDivisor;\n\n    public int Current => Volatile.Read(ref _current);\n\n    public void Change(int divisor)\n    {\n        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfLessThan(divisor, MinimumDivisor);\n        Volatile.Write(ref _current, divisor);\n    }\n}\n"

  "content": "using CashRegister.Features.Change.Money;\nusing CashRegister.Features.Change.Rules;\nusing CashRegister.Features.Change.Strategies;\n\nnamespace CashRegister.Features.Change;\n\n/// <summary>\n/// Picks how to make change: the matching rule with the lowest priority value decides the\n/// strategy (AC-024); with no match, minimal change is used (AC-003).\n/// </summary>\ninternal sealed class ChangeCalculator\n{\n    private readonly List<IChangeRule> _rulesByPriority;\n    private readonly Dictionary<Type, IChangeStrategy> _strategiesByType;\n    private readonly IChangeStrategy _minimalChange;\n\n    public ChangeCalculator(IEnumerable<IChangeRule> rules, IEnumerable<IChangeStrategy> strategies)\n    {\n        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(rules);\n        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(strategies);\n\n        // OrderBy is stable, so rules with equal priority keep their registration order.\n        _rulesByPriority = [.. rules.OrderBy(r => r.Priority)];\n        _strategiesByType = strategies.ToDictionary(s => s.GetType());\n        _minimalChange = StrategyOfType(typeof(MinimalChangeStrategy));\n\n        // Fail at startup rather than on the first matching transaction.\n        foreach (var rule in _rulesByPriority)\n        {\n            StrategyOfType(rule.StrategyType);\n        }\n    }\n\n    public IReadOnlyList<ChangeLine> Calculate(Transaction transaction)\n    {\n        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(transaction);\n\n        var matchingRule = _rulesByPriority.FirstOrDefault(r => r.Matches(transaction));\n        var strategy = matchingRule is null ? _minimalChange : _strategiesByType[matchingRule.StrategyType];\n\n        return strategy.MakeChange(transaction.ChangeDue, transaction.Currency);\n    }\n\n    private IChangeStrategy StrategyOfType(Type strategyType) =>\n        _strategiesByType.TryGetValue(strategyType, out var strategy)\n            ? strategy\n            : throw new InvalidOperationException($\"No change strategy of type {strategyType.Name} is registered.\");\n}\n"

## Assistant · 2026-09-21T17:46:31.621Z

T-005 is done. The rules, the divisor setting and the change calculator are in place, and all 61 tests pass (60 unit, 1 integration).

**What's in place**
- **`InMemoryDivisorSettings`:** the divisor starts at 3, can be changed at runtime, and rejects values below 1 while keeping the old value (AC-025). It's safe to read and change from several requests at once.
- **`OwedDivisibleByRule`:** picks random change when the amount owed in cents is divisible by the current divisor (AC-004, AC-013). Its priority is 100, which leaves room for future rules above or below it.
- **`ChangeCalculator`:** when several rules match, the lowest priority value wins, and a tie goes to the rule registered first (AC-024). With no match it uses the fewest-coins method (AC-003). A rule that points to an unregistered method makes startup fail, rather than failing on the first matching transaction.

**Gates:** format check clean, Release build with 0 warnings, 100% line and branch coverage on the new classes.

**Things you should know**
- **Rename:** the analyzer rule CA1716 rejected `IDivisorSettings.Set` because `Set` is a keyword in VB, so the method is now `Change(int divisor)`. T-011's endpoint will call it by that name.
- **Test bug fixed:** the "divisor change applies next time" test checked the coin count, but the fewest-coins result for $1.00 is also a count of 1. It now checks which denomination came back.
- **Coverage gaps closed:** the null-settings check and the `Priority` value each needed a direct test to reach 100%.

Commit message:
```
feat(change): add priority-based change rules, divisor settings and ChangeCalculator (T-005)
```

Then run `/net-build T-006` (output formatting).

## User · 2026-09-21T17:48:19.073Z

# /net-build

**Phase:** 4 — build (TDD)
**Owning agent:** `.claude/agents/dotnet-implementer.md` (collaborates with `dotnet-test-engineer`)
**Skills used:** `tdd-red-green-refactor`, `dotnet-10-conventions`, `clarity-over-cleverness`, `dotnet-testing-patterns`, `dotnet-task-decomposition`

## Purpose
Execute one task end-to-end through the four TDD phases (red → green → refactor → simplify), updating `.tdd-state.json` and appending a block to `05-implementation-log.md` after each phase.

## Inputs
- `<task-id>` (e.g. `T-001`). Required.

## Reads
- `.specs/<feature-id>/04-tasks.md`
- `.specs/<feature-id>/03-design.md`
- `.specs/<feature-id>/.tdd-state.json`
- `.claude/skills/tdd-red-green-refactor/SKILL.md` (authoritative)
- `.claude/skills/dotnet-testing-patterns/SKILL.md` (scope selection and the `[Trait("AC", ...)]` contract)

## Writes
- `tests/<Module>.Tests/**`, `tests/<Module>.IntegrationTests/**` and `src/<Module>/Features/<Slice>/**` files listed in `tasks[<task-id>].files_in_scope`.
- `.specs/<feature-id>/.tdd-state.json` (phase transitions; `tasks` is a map keyed by task id with a top-level `active_task`).
- `.specs/<feature-id>/05-implementation-log.md` (one `### <task-id> — <phase>` block per phase).

## Process
For the supplied `<task-id>`:

0. **Pre-flight commit check.** Run `git status`. If there are uncommitted changes from any prior task, refuse to start. List the changed files and remind: `git commit → /net-build <task-id>`.
1. **Activate.** Set `.tdd-state.json` `active_task = <task-id>`. Refuse if any other task is `phase: red|green|refactor|simplify` (one task in flight at a time).
2. **Red** (`dotnet-test-engineer`). Write the smallest test that captures the next AC slice, with the attribute block in order: `[Fact]`/`[Theory]` → `[Trait("AC", "AC-NNN")]` → `[Trait("Category", "Integration")]` when it needs a container or the full host. Run it with `dotnet test --filter "FullyQualifiedName~ClassName.MethodName"`. Confirm it fails on an assertion, not a compile error. Capture the failure message into `tasks[<task-id>].red_failure_excerpt`. Set `phase: "red"`. Append log block.
3. **Green** (`dotnet-implementer`). Write the minimum production code under `files_in_scope` to pass the test. Re-run the single test, then `dotnet test --filter "Category!=Integration"` for the unit suite (plus `dotnet test --filter "Category=Integration"` when integration files were touched). Set `phase: "green"`. Append log block.
4. **Refactor.** Improve structure without changing behavior or public signatures. Re-run the suite after every edit. Set `phase: "refactor"`. Append log block.
5. **Simplify.** Apply `clarity-over-cleverness` (untangle ternaries, inline once-used helpers, kill dead options, name domain concepts from the `01-spec.md` glossary, extract every literal that appears 2+ times in a file). Run `dotnet format --verify-no-changes` and `dotnet build -c Release` (warning-free) plus the suite. Set `phase: "simplify"`. Append log block.
6. **Done.** Set `phase: "done"`, clear `active_task`. If more ACs in this task remain uncovered, immediately re-run from step 2 with the next slice (do not declare done early).
7. **STOP — commit reminder.** Surface: files changed (`git status`), tests passing, suggested commit message. Recommend: `git status → git commit → /net-build <next-task-id>`. Do not auto-start the next task unless the user explicitly requests chaining.

## Refuse if
- `<task-id>` is not in `.tdd-state.json`, or `.tdd-state.json` has an array-shaped `tasks` value (the hooks reject it — re-run `/net-plan`).
- Another task is mid-flight (not `pending` or `done`).
- A `src/**/*.cs` edit is attempted while `phase != "red"` and `red_failure_excerpt` is empty (also enforced by the Claude hook `block-impl-without-failing-test.sh`).
- Any edit lands outside `tasks[<task-id>].files_in_scope` (enforced by `enforce-files-in-scope.sh`).
- A skip or gate-weakening flag would be needed — `dotnet test --no-build`, `-p:SkipTests`, `-p:RunAnalyzers=false`, `-p:TreatWarningsAsErrors=false` (enforced by `forbid-skip-flags.sh`).
- The spec or design leaves the edge case undefined — halt and open a `Q-NNN` instead of choosing a silent default (`block-progress-on-open-questions.sh`).
- A new NuGet package would be needed and the user has not confirmed it (version goes in `Directory.Packages.props`, never inline on the `PackageReference`).

## Done when
- Every AC listed under `tasks[<task-id>].acs_covered` has at least one test carrying `[Trait("AC", "AC-NNN")]`.
- All four phase blocks are present in `05-implementation-log.md` for this task.
- `.tdd-state.json` shows `phase: "done"` for `<task-id>` and `active_task` is cleared.
- `dotnet format --verify-no-changes` is clean and `dotnet build -c Release` produces no warnings.
- Commit reminder surfaced (Step 7); user commits before starting the next task. After all tasks done, run `/net-test` then `/net-validate`.

{
  "file_path": "C:\\dev\\CashRegister\\src\\CashRegister\\Features\\Change\\Formatting\\ChangeFormatter.cs",
  "content": "using CashRegister.Features.Change.Money;\n\nnamespace CashRegister.Features.Change.Formatting;\n\n/// <summary>\n/// Renders change as one output line, e.g. <c>3 quarters,1 dime,3 pennies</c> (AC-006).\n/// </summary>\ninternal static class ChangeFormatter\n{\n    /// <summary>Output when the amount paid equals the amount owed (AC-016).</summary>\n    public const string NoChange = \"No change\";\n\n    private const string EntrySeparator = \",\";\n\n    public static string Format(IReadOnlyList<ChangeLine> lines)\n    {\n        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(lines);\n\n        var entries = lines\n            .Where(line => line.Count > 0)                                   // AC-008\n            .OrderByDescending(line => line.Denomination.ValueInMinorUnits)  // AC-007\n            .Select(line => $\"{line.Count} {line.Denomination.NameFor(line.Count)}\") // AC-009, AC-010\n            .ToList();\n\n        if (entries.Count == 0)\n        {\n            return NoChange;\n        }\n\n        return string.Join(EntrySeparator, entries);\n    }\n}\n"
}
```

T-006 is done. The change formatter is in place, and all 70 tests pass (69 unit, 1 integration).

**What `ChangeFormatter.Format` does**
- Writes entries as `1 dollar,2 quarters,1 nickel`: comma-separated count and name (AC-006).
- Sorts largest denomination first, even if the input is unordered, so the output doesn't depend on which change method ran (AC-007).
- Leaves out zero counts (AC-008).
- Uses the singular name for 1 and the plural otherwise (AC-009, AC-010).
- Returns `No change` when there's nothing to hand back (AC-016).
- Matches both README samples exactly: `3 quarters,1 dime,3 pennies` and `3 pennies` (AC-011, AC-012).

**Gates:** format check clean, Release build with 0 warnings, 100% line and branch coverage.

One small change: `.editorconfig` now names private constants in PascalCase. The underscore rule was catching them, just as it caught static readonly fields in T-002.

Commit message:
```
feat(change): add ChangeFormatter with ordering, pluralisation and "No change" (T-006)
```

Then run `/net-build T-007` (the line parser).

## User · 2026-09-21T17:57:11.525Z

# /net-build

**Phase:** 4 — build (TDD)
**Owning agent:** `.claude/agents/dotnet-implementer.md` (collaborates with `dotnet-test-engineer`)
**Skills used:** `tdd-red-green-refactor`, `dotnet-10-conventions`, `clarity-over-cleverness`, `dotnet-testing-patterns`, `dotnet-task-decomposition`

## Purpose
Execute one task end-to-end through the four TDD phases (red → green → refactor → simplify), updating `.tdd-state.json` and appending a block to `05-implementation-log.md` after each phase.

## Inputs
- `<task-id>` (e.g. `T-001`). Required.

## Reads
- `.specs/<feature-id>/04-tasks.md`
- `.specs/<feature-id>/03-design.md`
- `.specs/<feature-id>/.tdd-state.json`
- `.claude/skills/tdd-red-green-refactor/SKILL.md` (authoritative)
- `.claude/skills/dotnet-testing-patterns/SKILL.md` (scope selection and the `[Trait("AC", ...)]` contract)

## Writes
- `tests/<Module>.Tests/**`, `tests/<Module>.IntegrationTests/**` and `src/<Module>/Features/<Slice>/**` files listed in `tasks[<task-id>].files_in_scope`.
- `.specs/<feature-id>/.tdd-state.json` (phase transitions; `tasks` is a map keyed by task id with a top-level `active_task`).
- `.specs/<feature-id>/05-implementation-log.md` (one `### <task-id> — <phase>` block per phase).

## Process
For the supplied `<task-id>`:

0. **Pre-flight commit check.** Run `git status`. If there are uncommitted changes from any prior task, refuse to start. List the changed files and remind: `git commit → /net-build <task-id>`.
1. **Activate.** Set `.tdd-state.json` `active_task = <task-id>`. Refuse if any other task is `phase: red|green|refactor|simplify` (one task in flight at a time).
2. **Red** (`dotnet-test-engineer`). Write the smallest test that captures the next AC slice, with the attribute block in order: `[Fact]`/`[Theory]` → `[Trait("AC", "AC-NNN")]` → `[Trait("Category", "Integration")]` when it needs a container or the full host. Run it with `dotnet test --filter "FullyQualifiedName~ClassName.MethodName"`. Confirm it fails on an assertion, not a compile error. Capture the failure message into `tasks[<task-id>].red_failure_excerpt`. Set `phase: "red"`. Append log block.
3. **Green** (`dotnet-implementer`). Write the minimum production code under `files_in_scope` to pass the test. Re-run the single test, then `dotnet test --filter "Category!=Integration"` for the unit suite (plus `dotnet test --filter "Category=Integration"` when integration files were touched). Set `phase: "green"`. Append log block.
4. **Refactor.** Improve structure without changing behavior or public signatures. Re-run the suite after every edit. Set `phase: "refactor"`. Append log block.
5. **Simplify.** Apply `clarity-over-cleverness` (untangle ternaries, inline once-used helpers, kill dead options, name domain concepts from the `01-spec.md` glossary, extract every literal that appears 2+ times in a file). Run `dotnet format --verify-no-changes` and `dotnet build -c Release` (warning-free) plus the suite. Set `phase: "simplify"`. Append log block.
6. **Done.** Set `phase: "done"`, clear `active_task`. If more ACs in this task remain uncovered, immediately re-run from step 2 with the next slice (do not declare done early).
7. **STOP — commit reminder.** Surface: files changed (`git status`), tests passing, suggested commit message. Recommend: `git status → git commit → /net-build <next-task-id>`. Do not auto-start the next task unless the user explicitly requests chaining.

## Refuse if
- `<task-id>` is not in `.tdd-state.json`, or `.tdd-state.json` has an array-shaped `tasks` value (the hooks reject it — re-run `/net-plan`).
- Another task is mid-flight (not `pending` or `done`).
- A `src/**/*.cs` edit is attempted while `phase != "red"` and `red_failure_excerpt` is empty (also enforced by the Claude hook `block-impl-without-failing-test.sh`).
- Any edit lands outside `tasks[<task-id>].files_in_scope` (enforced by `enforce-files-in-scope.sh`).
- A skip or gate-weakening flag would be needed — `dotnet test --no-build`, `-p:SkipTests`, `-p:RunAnalyzers=false`, `-p:TreatWarningsAsErrors=false` (enforced by `forbid-skip-flags.sh`).
- The spec or design leaves the edge case undefined — halt and open a `Q-NNN` instead of choosing a silent default (`block-progress-on-open-questions.sh`).
- A new NuGet package would be needed and the user has not confirmed it (version goes in `Directory.Packages.props`, never inline on the `PackageReference`).

## Done when
- Every AC listed under `tasks[<task-id>].acs_covered` has at least one test carrying `[Trait("AC", "AC-NNN")]`.
- All four phase blocks are present in `05-implementation-log.md` for this task.
- `.tdd-state.json` shows `phase: "done"` for `<task-id>` and `active_task` is cleared.
- `dotnet format --verify-no-changes` is clean and `dotnet build -c Release` produces no warnings.
- Commit reminder surfaced (Step 7); user commits before starting the next task. After all tasks done, run `/net-test` then `/net-validate`.

  "content": "using CashRegister.Features.Change.Parsing;\nusing CashRegister.Features.Currencies;\n\nnamespace CashRegister.Tests.Features.Change.Parsing;\n\npublic sealed class TransactionLineParserTests\n{\n    private static readonly UsdCurrency Usd = new();\n\n    /// <summary>A currency whose decimal separator is an apostrophe, to prove the separator comes from the currency.</summary>\n    private sealed class ApostropheCurrency() : Currency(\"APO\", '\\'', 2, [new(\"unit\", \"units\", 1)]);\n\n    private static LineParseResult Parse(string line) =>   "content": "using System.Globalization;\nusing CashRegister.Features.Change.Money;\nusing CashRegister.Features.Currencies;\n\nnamespace CashRegister.Features.Change.Parsing;\n\n/// <summary>\n/// Parses an <c>owed,paid</c> line into a <see cref=\"Transaction\"/> in minor units.\n/// Checks run in the order set by ADR-007: format, negative, decimal places, paid &lt; owed.\n/// </summary>\ninternal static class TransactionLineParser\n{\n    private const char FieldSeparator = ',';\n    private const char MinusSign = '-';\n\n    public static LineParseResult Parse(string line, Currency currency)\n    {\n        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(line);\n        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(currency);\n\n        var fields = line.Split(FieldSeparator);\n        if (fields.Length != 2)\n        {\n            return LineParseResult.Failure(LineErrors.InvalidLine);\n        }\n\n        var owedAmount = ParsedAmount.From(fields[0], currency);\n        var paidAmount = ParsedAmount.From(fields[1], currency);\n\n        if (owedAmount is null || paidAmount is null)\n        {\n            return LineParseResult.Failure(LineErrors.InvalidLine);\n        }\n\n        if (owedAmount.IsNegative || paidAmount.IsNegative)\n        {\n            return LineParseResult.Failure(LineErrors.NegativeAmount);\n        }\n\n        if (owedAmount.DecimalPlaces > currency.MinorUnitDigits || paidAmount.DecimalPlaces > currency.MinorUnitDigits)\n        {\n            return LineParseResult.Failure(LineErrors.TooManyDecimalPlaces(currency.MinorUnitDigits));\n        }\n\n        var owed = owedAmount.ToMinorUnits(currency.MinorUnitDigits);\n        var paid = paidAmount.ToMinorUnits(currency.MinorUnitDigits);\n\n        if (owed is null || paid is null)\n        {\n            return LineParseResult.Failure(LineErrors.InvalidLine);\n        }\n\n        if (paid < owed)\n        {\n            return LineParseResult.Failure(LineErrors.PaidLessThanOwed);\n        }\n\n        return LineParseResult.Success(new Transaction(owed.Value, paid.Value, currency));\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// One amount split into its parts. Only digits, an optional leading minus and at most one\n    /// currency decimal separator are accepted: no symbols or thousands separators (Q-013).\n    /// </summary>\n    private sealed record ParsedAmount(bool IsNegative, string WholeDigits, string FractionDigits)\n    {\n        public int DecimalPlaces => FractionDigits.Length;\n\n        public static ParsedAmount? From(string field, Currency currency)\n        {\n            var text = field.Trim();\n\n            var isNegative = text.StartsWith(MinusSign);\n            if (isNegative)\n            {\n                text = text[1..];\n            }\n\n            var parts = text.Split(currency.DecimalSeparator);\n            if (parts.Length > 2)\n            {\n                return null;\n            }\n\n            var wholeDigits = parts[0];\n            var fractionDigits = parts.Length == 2 ? parts[1] : string.Empty;\n            var hasSeparator = parts.Length == 2;\n\n            if (!IsDigitsOnly(wholeDigits) || (hasSeparator && !IsDigitsOnly(fractionDigits)))\n            {\n                return null;\n            }\n\n            return new ParsedAmount(isNegative, wholeDigits, fractionDigits);\n        }\n\n        /// <returns>The amount in minor units, or <c>null</c> if it is too large to hold.</returns>\n        public long? ToMinorUnits(int minorUnitDigits)\n        {\n            var digits = WholeDigits + FractionDigits.PadRight(minorUnitDigits, '0');\n            return long.TryParse(digits, NumberStyles.None, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var minorUnits)\n                ? minorUnits\n                : null;\n        }\n\n        private static bool IsDigitsOnly(string text) => text.Length > 0 && text.All(char.IsAsciiDigit);\n    }\n}\n"
}

## Assistant · 2026-09-21T18:01:55.299Z

T-007 is done. The line parser is in place, and all 96 tests pass (95 unit, 1 integration).

**What `TransactionLineParser.Parse` does:** it turns a line like `2.12,3.00` into a transaction in cents, or into an error message written on that output line. It checks in this order, and the first failure wins (ADR-007):

| Check | Output on failure |
|---|---|
| Not exactly two amounts, or anything other than digits, a leading `-` and one decimal separator | `Error: invalid line, expected '<owed>,<paid>'` (AC-017) |
| A negative amount | `Error: amounts must not be negative` (AC-018) |
| More than 2 decimal places | `Error: amounts must have at most 2 decimal places` (AC-020) |
| Paid less than owed | `Error: amount paid is less than amount owed` (AC-019) |

- **Accepted inputs:** spaces around amounts are trimmed, and whole dollars like `5,6` are fine.
- **Rejected as invalid lines:** `$`, thousands separators, `1.` and `.50`. An amount too large to store is also treated as an invalid line.
- **Decimal separator comes from the currency (AC-029):** a test currency using `'` parses `1'50`, while USD rejects it.

**Gates:** format check clean, Release build with 0 warnings. Coverage of the amount parser was just under the 95% target for new code, so I added two malformed cases (two decimal points, and a letter after the point). It's now 100% line and branch.

Commit message:
```
feat(change): add transaction line parser with per-line error messages (T-007)
```

Then run `/net-build T-008` (the file processor, which puts parsing, calculation and formatting together).

## User · 2026-09-21T18:03:25.918Z

# /net-build

**Phase:** 4 — build (TDD)
**Owning agent:** `.claude/agents/dotnet-implementer.md` (collaborates with `dotnet-test-engineer`)
**Skills used:** `tdd-red-green-refactor`, `dotnet-10-conventions`, `clarity-over-cleverness`, `dotnet-testing-patterns`, `dotnet-task-decomposition`

## Purpose
Execute one task end-to-end through the four TDD phases (red → green → refactor → simplify), updating `.tdd-state.json` and appending a block to `05-implementation-log.md` after each phase.

## Inputs
- `<task-id>` (e.g. `T-001`). Required.

## Reads
- `.specs/<feature-id>/04-tasks.md`
- `.specs/<feature-id>/03-design.md`
- `.specs/<feature-id>/.tdd-state.json`
- `.claude/skills/tdd-red-green-refactor/SKILL.md` (authoritative)
- `.claude/skills/dotnet-testing-patterns/SKILL.md` (scope selection and the `[Trait("AC", ...)]` contract)

## Writes
- `tests/<Module>.Tests/**`, `tests/<Module>.IntegrationTests/**` and `src/<Module>/Features/<Slice>/**` files listed in `tasks[<task-id>].files_in_scope`.
- `.specs/<feature-id>/.tdd-state.json` (phase transitions; `tasks` is a map keyed by task id with a top-level `active_task`).
- `.specs/<feature-id>/05-implementation-log.md` (one `### <task-id> — <phase>` block per phase).

## Process
For the supplied `<task-id>`:

0. **Pre-flight commit check.** Run `git status`. If there are uncommitted changes from any prior task, refuse to start. List the changed files and remind: `git commit → /net-build <task-id>`.
1. **Activate.** Set `.tdd-state.json` `active_task = <task-id>`. Refuse if any other task is `phase: red|green|refactor|simplify` (one task in flight at a time).
2. **Red** (`dotnet-test-engineer`). Write the smallest test that captures the next AC slice, with the attribute block in order: `[Fact]`/`[Theory]` → `[Trait("AC", "AC-NNN")]` → `[Trait("Category", "Integration")]` when it needs a container or the full host. Run it with `dotnet test --filter "FullyQualifiedName~ClassName.MethodName"`. Confirm it fails on an assertion, not a compile error. Capture the failure message into `tasks[<task-id>].red_failure_excerpt`. Set `phase: "red"`. Append log block.
3. **Green** (`dotnet-implementer`). Write the minimum production code under `files_in_scope` to pass the test. Re-run the single test, then `dotnet test --filter "Category!=Integration"` for the unit suite (plus `dotnet test --filter "Category=Integration"` when integration files were touched). Set `phase: "green"`. Append log block.
4. **Refactor.** Improve structure without changing behavior or public signatures. Re-run the suite after every edit. Set `phase: "refactor"`. Append log block.
5. **Simplify.** Apply `clarity-over-cleverness` (untangle ternaries, inline once-used helpers, kill dead options, name domain concepts from the `01-spec.md` glossary, extract every literal that appears 2+ times in a file). Run `dotnet format --verify-no-changes` and `dotnet build -c Release` (warning-free) plus the suite. Set `phase: "simplify"`. Append log block.
6. **Done.** Set `phase: "done"`, clear `active_task`. If more ACs in this task remain uncovered, immediately re-run from step 2 with the next slice (do not declare done early).
7. **STOP — commit reminder.** Surface: files changed (`git status`), tests passing, suggested commit message. Recommend: `git status → git commit → /net-build <next-task-id>`. Do not auto-start the next task unless the user explicitly requests chaining.

## Refuse if
- `<task-id>` is not in `.tdd-state.json`, or `.tdd-state.json` has an array-shaped `tasks` value (the hooks reject it — re-run `/net-plan`).
- Another task is mid-flight (not `pending` or `done`).
- A `src/**/*.cs` edit is attempted while `phase != "red"` and `red_failure_excerpt` is empty (also enforced by the Claude hook `block-impl-without-failing-test.sh`).
- Any edit lands outside `tasks[<task-id>].files_in_scope` (enforced by `enforce-files-in-scope.sh`).
- A skip or gate-weakening flag would be needed — `dotnet test --no-build`, `-p:SkipTests`, `-p:RunAnalyzers=false`, `-p:TreatWarningsAsErrors=false` (enforced by `forbid-skip-flags.sh`).
- The spec or design leaves the edge case undefined — halt and open a `Q-NNN` instead of choosing a silent default (`block-progress-on-open-questions.sh`).
- A new NuGet package would be needed and the user has not confirmed it (version goes in `Directory.Packages.props`, never inline on the `PackageReference`).

## Done when
- Every AC listed under `tasks[<task-id>].acs_covered` has at least one test carrying `[Trait("AC", "AC-NNN")]`.
- All four phase blocks are present in `05-implementation-log.md` for this task.
- `.tdd-state.json` shows `phase: "done"` for `<task-id>` and `active_task` is cleared.
- `dotnet format --verify-no-changes` is clean and `dotnet build -c Release` produces no warnings.
- Commit reminder surfaced (Step 7); user commits before starting the next task. After all tasks done, run `/net-test` then `/net-validate`.

\\n2.12,3.00\\r\\n\\t\\n1.97,2.00\\n\\n\");\n\n        result.OutputLines.Count.ShouldBe(2);\n        result.LineCount.ShouldBe(2);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    [Trait(\"AC\", \"AC-002\")]\n    public throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(calculator));\n    private readonly ILogger<ChangeFileProcessor> _logger = logger ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(logger));\n\n    public async Task<ProcessedFile> ProcessAsync(\n        Stream input,\n        string fileName,\n        Currency currency,\n        CancellationToken cancellationToken)\n    {\n        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(input);\n        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(fileName);\n        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(currency);\n\n        var startedAt = Stopwatch.GetTimestamp();\n        var outputLines = new List<string>();\n        var errorLineCount = 0;\n\n        using var reader = new StreamReader(input);\n        while (await reader.ReadLineAsync(cancellationToken) is { } line)\n        {\n            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(line))\n            {\n                continue; // AC-022\n            }\n\n            if (outputLines.Count == MaxLines)\n            {\n                _logger.FileRejected(fileName, $\"more than {MaxLines} lines\");\n                return ProcessedFile.TooManyLines();\n            }\n\n            var parsed = TransactionLineParser.Parse(line, currency);\n            if (parsed.Transaction is null)\n            {\n                outputLines.Add(parsed.Error!);\n                errorLineCount++;\n                continue; // AC-021\n            }\n\n            var change = _calculator.Calculate(parsed.Transaction);\n            outputLines.Add(ChangeFormatter.Format(change));\n        }\n\n        var elapsedMs = (long)Stopwatch.GetElapsedTime(startedAt).TotalMilliseconds;\n        _logger.FileProcessed(fileName, outputLines.Count, errorLineCount, elapsedMs);\n\n        return ProcessedFile.Completed(outputLines, errorLineCount);\n    }\n}\n"
}

## Assistant · 2026-09-21T18:09:05.740Z

T-008 is done. The file processor now joins up parsing, calculation and formatting, and all 110 tests pass (109 unit, 1 integration).

**What `ChangeFileProcessor.ProcessAsync` does**
- Reads the file line by line and skips blank or whitespace-only lines (AC-022).
- Gives each remaining line one output line, in the same order (AC-001, AC-002). That's either the change or the line's error message; after an error it carries on with the next line (AC-021).
- Stops reading and rejects the file as soon as it sees a 1001st non-blank line. Exactly 1000 lines is fine (AC-023).
- Output lines are joined with `\n` and have no trailing newline.
- On the README sample it gives 3 lines. The first two match the README exactly (AC-011, AC-012); the third is random, since 333 is divisible by 3.

**Logging (NFR-002):** each processed file logs its line count, error count and time taken, and a rejected file logs a warning. File contents are never logged.

**Gates:** format check clean, Release build with 0 warnings, 100% line and branch coverage on all three classes.

**Changes from the plan**
- **Divisor log event moved to T-011:** it had no code path yet, so it left a coverage gap. I removed it and added `CashRegisterLog.cs` to T-011's files in both `04-tasks.md` and `.tdd-state.json`, so T-011 can add it back.
- **Log uses the file name, not a file ID:** IDs are assigned later by the file store (T-010).
- **Dead fallback removed:** a parse result always carries either a transaction or an error, so I removed a fallback that could never run and added a comment saying why.

Commit message:
```
feat(change): add ChangeFileProcessor with blank-line skipping, 1000-line limit and logging (T-008)
```

Then run `/net-build T-009` (module registration and the API host).

Execute one task end-to-end through the four TDD phases (red → green → refactor → simplify), updating `.tdd-state.json` and appending a block to `05-implementation-log.md` after each phase.

## Inputs
- `<task-id>` (e.g. `T-001`). Required.

## Reads
- `.specs/<feature-id>/04-tasks.md`
- `.specs/<feature-id>/03-design.md`
- `.specs/<feature-id>/.tdd-state.json`
- `.claude/skills/tdd-red-green-refactor/SKILL.md` (authoritative)
- `.claude/skills/dotnet-testing-patterns/SKILL.md` (scope selection and the `[Trait("AC", ...)]` contract)

## Writes
- `tests/<Module>.Tests/**`, `tests/<Module>.IntegrationTests/**` and `src/<Module>/Features/<Slice>/**` files listed in `tasks[<task-id>].files_in_scope`.
- `.specs/<feature-id>/.tdd-state.json` (phase transitions; `tasks` is a map keyed by task id with a top-level `active_task`).
- `.specs/<feature-id>/05-implementation-log.md` (one `### <task-id> — <phase>` block per phase).

## Process
For the supplied `<task-id>`:

0. **Pre-flight commit check.** Run `git status`. If there are uncommitted changes from any prior task, refuse to start. List the changed files and remind: `git commit → /net-build <task-id>`.
1. **Activate.** Set `.tdd-state.json` `active_task = <task-id>`. Refuse if any other task is `phase: red|green|refactor|simplify` (one task in flight at a time).
2. **Red** (`dotnet-test-engineer`). Write the smallest test that captures the next AC slice, with the attribute block in order: `[Fact]`/`[Theory]` → `[Trait("AC", "AC-NNN")]` → `[Trait("Category", "Integration")]` when it needs a container or the full host. Run it with `dotnet test --filter "FullyQualifiedName~ClassName.MethodName"`. Confirm it fails on an assertion, not a compile error. Capture the failure message into `tasks[<task-id>].red_failure_excerpt`. Set `phase: "red"`. Append log block.
3. **Green** (`dotnet-implementer`). Write the minimum production code under `files_in_scope` to pass the test. Re-run the single test, then `dotnet test --filter "Category!=Integration"` for the unit suite (plus `dotnet test --filter "Category=Integration"` when integration files were touched). Set `phase: "green"`. Append log block.
4. **Refactor.** Improve structure without changing behavior or public signatures. Re-run the suite after every edit. Set `phase: "refactor"`. Append log block.
5. **Simplify.** Apply `clarity-over-cleverness` (untangle ternaries, inline once-used helpers, kill dead options, name domain concepts from the `01-spec.md` glossary, extract every literal that appears 2+ times in a file). Run `dotnet format --verify-no-changes` and `dotnet build -c Release` (warning-free) plus the suite. Set `phase: "simplify"`. Append log block.
6. **Done.** Set `phase: "done"`, clear `active_task`. If more ACs in this task remain uncovered, immediately re-run from step 2 with the next slice (do not declare done early).
7. **STOP — commit reminder.** Surface: files changed (`git status`), tests passing, suggested commit message. Recommend: `git status → git commit → /net-build <next-task-id>`. Do not auto-start the next task unless the user explicitly requests chaining.

## Refuse if
- `<task-id>` is not in `.tdd-state.json`, or `.tdd-state.json` has an array-shaped `tasks` value (the hooks reject it — re-run `/net-plan`).
- Another task is mid-flight (not `pending` or `done`).
- A `src/**/*.cs` edit is attempted while `phase != "red"` and `red_failure_excerpt` is empty (also enforced by the Claude hook `block-impl-without-failing-test.sh`).
- Any edit lands outside `tasks[<task-id>].files_in_scope` (enforced by `enforce-files-in-scope.sh`).
- A skip or gate-weakening flag would be needed — `dotnet test --no-build`, `-p:SkipTests`, `-p:RunAnalyzers=false`, `-p:TreatWarningsAsErrors=false` (enforced by `forbid-skip-flags.sh`).
- The spec or design leaves the edge case undefined — halt and open a `Q-NNN` instead of choosing a silent default (`block-progress-on-open-questions.sh`).
- A new NuGet package would be needed and the user has not confirmed it (version goes in `Directory.Packages.props`, never inline on the `PackageReference`).

## Done when
- Every AC listed under `tasks[<task-id>].acs_covered` has at least one test carrying `[Trait("AC", "AC-NNN")]`.
- All four phase blocks are present in `05-implementation-log.md` for this task.
- `.tdd-state.json` shows `phase: "done"` for `<task-id>` and `active_task` is cleared.
- `dotnet format --verify-no-changes` is clean and `dotnet build -c Release` produces no warnings.
- Commit reminder surfaced (Step 7); user commits before starting the next task. After all tasks done, run `/net-test` then `/net-validate`.

CashRegister.Tests;\n\npublic sealed class CashRegisterModuleTests\n{\n    private static ServiceProvider BuildProvider(string? currencyCode = null)\n    {\n        var settings = new Dictionary<string, string?>();\n        if (currencyCode is not null)\n        {\n            settings[\"CashRegister:Currency\"] = currencyCode;\n        }\n\n        var configuration = new ConfigurationBuilder().AddInMemoryCollection(settings).Build();\n\n        var services = new ServiceCollection();\n        services.AddLogging();\n        services.AddCashRegister(configuration);\n\n        return services.BuildServiceProvider(new ServiceProviderOptions { ValidateOnBuild = true, ValidateScopes = true });\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void AddCashRegister_ResolvesTheFileProcessor()\n    {\n        using var provider = BuildProvider();\n\n        provider.GetService<ChangeFileProcessor>().ShouldNotBeNull();\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void AddCashRegister_RegistersBothChangeStrategies()\n    {\n        using var provider = BuildProvider();\n\n        provider.GetServices<IChangeStrategy>().Select(s => s.GetType())\n            .ShouldBe([typeof(MinimalChangeStrategy), typeof(RandomChangeStrategy)], ignoreOrder: true);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void AddCashRegister_RegistersTheDivisibleByRuleAndASingleDivisorSetting()\n    {\n        using var provider = BuildProvider();\n\n        provider.GetServices<IChangeRule>().Single().ShouldBeOfType<OwedDivisibleByRule>();\n        provider.GetRequiredService<IDivisorSettings>()\n            .ShouldBeSameAs(provider.GetRequiredService<IDivisorSettings>());\n        provider.GetService<ChangeCalculator>().ShouldNotBeNull();\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void ActiveCurrency_DefaultsToUsd()\n    {\n        using var provider = BuildProvider();\n\n        provider.GetRequiredService<ActiveCurrency>().Currency.ShouldBeOfType<UsdCurrency>();\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void ActiveCurrency_ConfiguredCodeIsCaseInsensitive()\n    {\n        using var provider = BuildProvider(\"usd\");\n\n        provider.GetRequiredService<ActiveCurrency>().Currency.Code.ShouldBe(\"USD\");\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Options_UnknownCurrency_FailValidation()\n    {\n        using var provider = BuildProvider(\"XYZ\");\n\n        var exception = Should.Throw<OptionsValidationException>(\n            () => provider.GetRequiredService<IOptions<CashRegisterOptions>>().Value);\n\n        exception.Message.ShouldContain(\"XYZ\");\n    }\n}\n"
}

var response = await _client.GetAsync(new Uri(\"/health\", UriKind.Relative), Cancellation);\n\n        response.StatusCode.ShouldBe(HttpStatusCode.OK);\n        (await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(Cancellation)).ShouldBe(\"Healthy\");\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    [Trait(\"AC\", \"AC-015\")]\n    [Trait(\"Category\", \"Integration\")]\n    public async Task response.StatusCode.ShouldBe(HttpStatusCode.NotFound);\n        response.Content.Headers.ContentType?.MediaType.ShouldBe(\"application/problem+json\");\n\n        var problem = await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<ProblemDetails>(Cancellation);\n        problem.ShouldNotBeNull();\n        problem.Status.ShouldBe(404);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    [Trait(\"Category\", \"Integration\")]\n    public async Task CorsPreflight_FromTheSpaOrigin_IsAllowed()\n    {\n        var response = await SendPreflight(SpaOrigin);\n\n   "new_string": "/// <summary>The currency uploaded files are processed in, resolved once from <see cref=\"CashRegisterOptions\"/>.</summary>\npublic sealed record ActiveCurrency(Currency Currency);\n\n/// <summary>Fails startup when the configured currency is not registered (ADR-004).</summary>\ninternal sealed class CashRegisterOptionsValidator(ICurrencyRegistry registry) : IValidateOptions<CashRegisterOptions>\n{\n    public ValidateOptionsResult Validate(string? name, CashRegisterOptions options)\n    {\n        if (registry.TryGet(options.Currency, out _))\n        {\n            return ValidateOptionsResult.Success;\n        }\n\n        var registered = string.Join(\", \", registry.All.Select(c => c.Code));\n        return ValidateOptionsResult.Fail(\n            $\"CashRegister:Currency '{options.Currency}' is not a registered currency. Registered: {registered}.\");\n    }\n}"

**Module (`AddCashRegister` / `MapCashRegister`)**
- **Services registered:**
  - USD and the currency registry;
  - both change methods, using `Random.Shared` for the random one;
  - one shared divisor setting, the divisible-by rule, the calculator and the file processor.
- **`ActiveCurrency`:** the currency files are processed in, read from `CashRegister:Currency` (default `USD`, case-insensitive).
- **Currency check at startup:** an unknown code stops the app, with a message that names the code and lists the registered currencies.
- **`MapCashRegister`:** empty for now; T-010 and T-011 add the endpoints.

**Host (`Program.cs`)**
- Errors come back as ProblemDetails, including a 404 for unknown `/api` routes (AC-015).
- `/health` returns `Healthy` (NFR-003).
- OpenAPI is exposed only in Development.
- CORS allows only the origins listed in `Cors:AllowedOrigins`, which is `http://localhost:5173` in Development. The tests confirm another origin is refused.
- Logs are written as JSON outside Development.

**Gates:** format check clean, Release build with 0 warnings. From unit tests alone, the module package is at 98.8% line and 100% branch coverage. The one gap is `MapCashRegister`, which only runs in the integration host and is 100% covered there.

## User · 2026-09-21T18:18:02.423Z

# /net-build

**Phase:** 4 — build (TDD)
**Owning agent:** `.claude/agents/dotnet-implementer.md` (collaborates with `dotnet-test-engineer`)
**Skills used:** `tdd-red-green-refactor`, `dotnet-10-conventions`, `clarity-over-cleverness`, `dotnet-testing-patterns`, `dotnet-task-decomposition`

## Purpose
Execute one task end-to-end through the four TDD phases (red → green → refactor → simplify), updating `.tdd-state.json` and appending a block to `05-implementation-log.md` after each phase.

## Inputs
- `<task-id>` (e.g. `T-001`). Required.

## Reads
- `.specs/<feature-id>/04-tasks.md`
- `.specs/<feature-id>/03-design.md`
- `.specs/<feature-id>/.tdd-state.json`
- `.claude/skills/tdd-red-green-refactor/SKILL.md` (authoritative)
- `.claude/skills/dotnet-testing-patterns/SKILL.md` (scope selection and the `[Trait("AC", ...)]` contract)

## Writes
- `tests/<Module>.Tests/**`, `tests/<Module>.IntegrationTests/**` and `src/<Module>/Features/<Slice>/**` files listed in `tasks[<task-id>].files_in_scope`.
- `.specs/<feature-id>/.tdd-state.json` (phase transitions; `tasks` is a map keyed by task id with a top-level `active_task`).
- `.specs/<feature-id>/05-implementation-log.md` (one `### <task-id> — <phase>` block per phase).

## Process
For the supplied `<task-id>`:

0. **Pre-flight commit check.** Run `git status`. If there are uncommitted changes from any prior task, refuse to start. List the changed files and remind: `git commit → /net-build <task-id>`.
1. **Activate.** Set `.tdd-state.json` `active_task = <task-id>`. Refuse if any other task is `phase: red|green|refactor|simplify` (one task in flight at a time).
2. **Red** (`dotnet-test-engineer`). Write the smallest test that captures the next AC slice, with the attribute block in order: `[Fact]`/`[Theory]` → `[Trait("AC", "AC-NNN")]` → `[Trait("Category", "Integration")]` when it needs a container or the full host. Run it with `dotnet test --filter "FullyQualifiedName~ClassName.MethodName"`. Confirm it fails on an assertion, not a compile error. Capture the failure message into `tasks[<task-id>].red_failure_excerpt`. Set `phase: "red"`. Append log block.
3. **Green** (`dotnet-implementer`). Write the minimum production code under `files_in_scope` to pass the test. Re-run the single test, then `dotnet test --filter "Category!=Integration"` for the unit suite (plus `dotnet test --filter "Category=Integration"` when integration files were touched). Set `phase: "green"`. Append log block.
4. **Refactor.** Improve structure without changing behavior or public signatures. Re-run the suite after every edit. Set `phase: "refactor"`. Append log block.
5. **Simplify.** Apply `clarity-over-cleverness` (untangle ternaries, inline once-used helpers, kill dead options, name domain concepts from the `01-spec.md` glossary, extract every literal that appears 2+ times in a file). Run `dotnet format --verify-no-changes` and `dotnet build -c Release` (warning-free) plus the suite. Set `phase: "simplify"`. Append log block.
6. **Done.** Set `phase: "done"`, clear `active_task`. If more ACs in this task remain uncovered, immediately re-run from step 2 with the next slice (do not declare done early).
7. **STOP — commit reminder.** Surface: files changed (`git status`), tests passing, suggested commit message. Recommend: `git status → git commit → /net-build <next-task-id>`. Do not auto-start the next task unless the user explicitly requests chaining.

## Refuse if
- `<task-id>` is not in `.tdd-state.json`, or `.tdd-state.json` has an array-shaped `tasks` value (the hooks reject it — re-run `/net-plan`).
- Another task is mid-flight (not `pending` or `done`).
- A `src/**/*.cs` edit is attempted while `phase != "red"` and `red_failure_excerpt` is empty (also enforced by the Claude hook `block-impl-without-failing-test.sh`).
- Any edit lands outside `tasks[<task-id>].files_in_scope` (enforced by `enforce-files-in-scope.sh`).
- A skip or gate-weakening flag would be needed — `dotnet test --no-build`, `-p:SkipTests`, `-p:RunAnalyzers=false`, `-p:TreatWarningsAsErrors=false` (enforced by `forbid-skip-flags.sh`).
- The spec or design leaves the edge case undefined — halt and open a `Q-NNN` instead of choosing a silent default (`block-progress-on-open-questions.sh`).
- A new NuGet package would be needed and the user has not confirmed it (version goes in `Directory.Packages.props`, never inline on the `PackageReference`).

## Done when
- Every AC listed under `tasks[<task-id>].acs_covered` has at least one test carrying `[Trait("AC", "AC-NNN")]`.
- All four phase blocks are present in `05-implementation-log.md` for this task.
- `.tdd-state.json` shows `phase: "done"` for `<task-id>` and `active_task` is cleared.
- `dotnet format --verify-no-changes` is clean and `dotnet build -c Release` produces no warnings.
- Commit reminder surfaced (Step 7); user commits before starting the next task. After all tasks done, run `/net-test` then `/net-validate`.

  "content": "using CashRegister.Features.Change.Files;\n\nnamespace CashRegister.Tests.Features.Change.Files;\n\npublic sealed class InMemoryUploadedFileStoreTests\n{\n    private static readonly DateTimeOffset Noon = new(2026, 9, 21, 12, 0, 0, TimeSpan.Zero);\n    private readonly InMemoryUploadedFileStore _store = new();\n\n    private static UploadedFile FileAt(DateTimeOffset uploadedAt, string name = \"input.txt\") =>\n        new(Guid.NewGuid(), name, uploadedAt, LineCount: 3, ErrorLineCount: 0, OutputText: \"3 pennies\");\n\n    [Fact]\n    [Trait(\"AC\", \"AC-028\")]\n    public void TryGet_AddedFile_ReturnsIt()\n    {\n        var file = FileAt(Noon);\n        _store.Add(file);\n\n        _store.TryGet(file.Id, out var found).ShouldBeTrue();\n        found.ShouldBe(file);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void TryGet_UnknownId_ReturnsFalse()\n    {\n        _store.TryGet(Guid.NewGuid(), out _).ShouldBeFalse();\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    [Trait(\"AC\", \"AC-027\")]\n    public void ListNewestFirst_OrdersByUploadTimeDescending()\n    {\n        var oldest = FileAt(Noon, \"a.txt\");\n        var newest = FileAt(Noon.AddMinutes(2), \"c.txt\");\n        var middle = FileAt(Noon.AddMinutes(1), \"b.txt\");\n        _store.Add(oldest);\n        _store.Add(newest);\n        _store.Add(middle);\n\n        _store.ListNewestFirst().Select(f => f.FileName).ShouldBe([\"c.txt\", \"b.txt\", \"a.txt\"]);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void ListNewestFirst_Empty_IsEmpty()\n    {\n        _store.ListNewestFirst().ShouldBeEmpty();\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task Add_FromManyThreads_KeepsEveryFile()\n    {\n        await Task.WhenAll(Enumerable.Range(0, 200).Select(i => Task.Run(() => _store.Add(FileAt(Noon.AddSeconds(i))))));\n\n        _store.ListNewestFirst().Count.ShouldBe(200);\n    }\n}\n"
}

## Assistant · 2026-09-21T18:42:02.345Z

T-010 is done. The upload, list and download endpoints work, and all 135 tests pass (120 unit, 15 integration).

**Endpoints**

| Endpoint | Success | Errors |
|---|---|---|
| `POST /api/files` (multipart form field `file`, 1 MB limit) | 201 with the file summary and a `Location` header (AC-001, AC-027) | 400 `Invalid file` if there's no file; 400 `Too many lines` over 1000 lines (AC-015, AC-023) |
| `GET /api/files` | 200, newest first (AC-027) | — |
| `GET /api/files/{id}/output` | 200, a plain-text download named `<name>-change.txt` (AC-028) | 404 `File not found` (AC-015) |

**Other behaviour**
- **Storage:** processed files are kept in memory and are thread-safe. The upload time comes from `TimeProvider`, so tests can control it.
- **File names:** folders and invalid characters are stripped, names are cut to 100 characters, and a name that ends up empty falls back to `upload.txt`.
- **Antiforgery:** turned off on the upload endpoint. There are no logins or cookies to protect in v1 (ADR-005).

**Gates:** format check clean, Release build with 0 warnings. The store has 100% coverage from unit tests, and the endpoints have 100% from integration tests. The endpoints were at 93.75% until I added a test for the `upload.txt` fallback. That test uses `folder/` as the name because `HttpClient` won't send a blank one.

The two test projects now write separate coverage files (`unit.xml` and `it.xml`), which fixes the overwrite problem I noted in T-009.

Commit message:
```
feat(files): add upload, list and download endpoints with in-memory file store (T-010)
```

Then run `/net-build T-011` (the divisor settings endpoints).

# /net-build

**Phase:** 4 — build (TDD)
**Owning agent:** `.claude/agents/dotnet-implementer.md` (collaborates with `dotnet-test-engineer`)
**Skills used:** `tdd-red-green-refactor`, `dotnet-10-conventions`, `clarity-over-cleverness`, `dotnet-testing-patterns`, `dotnet-task-decomposition`

## Purpose
Execute one task end-to-end through the four TDD phases (red → green → refactor → simplify), updating `.tdd-state.json` and appending a block to `05-implementation-log.md` after each phase.

## Inputs
- `<task-id>` (e.g. `T-001`). Required.

## Reads
- `.specs/<feature-id>/04-tasks.md`
- `.specs/<feature-id>/03-design.md`
- `.specs/<feature-id>/.tdd-state.json`
- `.claude/skills/tdd-red-green-refactor/SKILL.md` (authoritative)
- `.claude/skills/dotnet-testing-patterns/SKILL.md` (scope selection and the `[Trait("AC", ...)]` contract)

## Writes
- `tests/<Module>.Tests/**`, `tests/<Module>.IntegrationTests/**` and `src/<Module>/Features/<Slice>/**` files listed in `tasks[<task-id>].files_in_scope`.
- `.specs/<feature-id>/.tdd-state.json` (phase transitions; `tasks` is a map keyed by task id with a top-level `active_task`).
- `.specs/<feature-id>/05-implementation-log.md` (one `### <task-id> — <phase>` block per phase).

## Process
For the supplied `<task-id>`:

0. **Pre-flight commit check.** Run `git status`. If there are uncommitted changes from any prior task, refuse to start. List the changed files and remind: `git commit → /net-build <task-id>`.
1. **Activate.** Set `.tdd-state.json` `active_task = <task-id>`. Refuse if any other task is `phase: red|green|refactor|simplify` (one task in flight at a time).
2. **Red** (`dotnet-test-engineer`). Write the smallest test that captures the next AC slice, with the attribute block in order: `[Fact]`/`[Theory]` → `[Trait("AC", "AC-NNN")]` → `[Trait("Category", "Integration")]` when it needs a container or the full host. Run it with `dotnet test --filter "FullyQualifiedName~ClassName.MethodName"`. Confirm it fails on an assertion, not a compile error. Capture the failure message into `tasks[<task-id>].red_failure_excerpt`. Set `phase: "red"`. Append log block.
3. **Green** (`dotnet-implementer`). Write the minimum production code under `files_in_scope` to pass the test. Re-run the single test, then `dotnet test --filter "Category!=Integration"` for the unit suite (plus `dotnet test --filter "Category=Integration"` when integration files were touched). Set `phase: "green"`. Append log block.
4. **Refactor.** Improve structure without changing behavior or public signatures. Re-run the suite after every edit. Set `phase: "refactor"`. Append log block.
5. **Simplify.** Apply `clarity-over-cleverness` (untangle ternaries, inline once-used helpers, kill dead options, name domain concepts from the `01-spec.md` glossary, extract every literal that appears 2+ times in a file). Run `dotnet format --verify-no-changes` and `dotnet build -c Release` (warning-free) plus the suite. Set `phase: "simplify"`. Append log block.
6. **Done.** Set `phase: "done"`, clear `active_task`. If more ACs in this task remain uncovered, immediately re-run from step 2 with the next slice (do not declare done early).
7. **STOP — commit reminder.** Surface: files changed (`git status`), tests passing, suggested commit message. Recommend: `git status → git commit → /net-build <next-task-id>`. Do not auto-start the next task unless the user explicitly requests chaining.

## Refuse if
- `<task-id>` is not in `.tdd-state.json`, or `.tdd-state.json` has an array-shaped `tasks` value (the hooks reject it — re-run `/net-plan`).
- Another task is mid-flight (not `pending` or `done`).
- A `src/**/*.cs` edit is attempted while `phase != "red"` and `red_failure_excerpt` is empty (also enforced by the Claude hook `block-impl-without-failing-test.sh`).
- Any edit lands outside `tasks[<task-id>].files_in_scope` (enforced by `enforce-files-in-scope.sh`).
- A skip or gate-weakening flag would be needed — `dotnet test --no-build`, `-p:SkipTests`, `-p:RunAnalyzers=false`, `-p:TreatWarningsAsErrors=false` (enforced by `forbid-skip-flags.sh`).
- The spec or design leaves the edge case undefined — halt and open a `Q-NNN` instead of choosing a silent default (`block-progress-on-open-questions.sh`).
- A new NuGet package would be needed and the user has not confirmed it (version goes in `Directory.Packages.props`, never inline on the `PackageReference`).

## Done when
- Every AC listed under `tasks[<task-id>].acs_covered` has at least one test carrying `[Trait("AC", "AC-NNN")]`.
- All four phase blocks are present in `05-implementation-log.md` for this task.
- `.tdd-state.json` shows `phase: "done"` for `<task-id>` and `active_task` is cleared.
- `dotnet format --verify-no-changes` is clean and `dotnet build -c Release` produces no warnings.
- Commit reminder surfaced (Step 7); user commits before starting the next task. After all tasks done, run `/net-test` then `/net-validate`.

  "content": "using CashRegister.Features.Change.Processing;\nusing CashRegister.Features.Change.Rules;\nusing Microsoft.AspNetCore.Builder;\nusing Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;\nusing Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http.HttpResults;\nusing Microsoft.AspNetCore.Routing;\nusing Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;\n\nnamespace CashRegister.Features.Change.Settings;\n\n/// <summary><c>/api/settings/divisor</c>: read or change the special-case divisor from the UI (AC-025).</summary>\ninternal static class DivisorEndpoints\n{\n    private const string LoggerCategory = \"CashRegister.Features.Change.Settings.DivisorEndpoints\";\n\n    public static IEndpointRouteBuilder MapDivisorEndpoints(this IEndpointRouteBuilder endpoints)\n    {\n        var divisor = endpoints.MapGroup(\"/api/settings/divisor\").WithTags(\"Settings\");\n\n        divisor.MapGet(\"/\", Get);\n        divisor.MapPut(\"/\", Change);\n\n        return endpoints;\n    }\n\n    private static Ok<DivisorResponse> Get(IDivisorSettings settings) =>\n        TypedResults.Ok(new DivisorResponse(settings.Current));\n\n    private static Results<Ok<DivisorResponse>, ProblemHttpResult> Change(\n        ChangeDivisorRequest request,\n        IDivisorSettings settings,\n        ILoggerFactory loggerFactory)\n    {\n        if (request.Divisor is not { } newDivisor || newDivisor < InMemoryDivisorSettings.MinimumDivisor)\n        {\n            return TypedResults.Problem(\n                title: \"Invalid divisor\",\n                detail: $\"The divisor must be a whole number of at least {InMemoryDivisorSettings.MinimumDivisor}.\",\n                statusCode: StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest);\n        }\n\n        var oldDivisor = settings.Current;\n        settings.Change(newDivisor);\n        loggerFactory.CreateLogger(LoggerCategory).DivisorChanged(oldDivisor, newDivisor);\n\n        return TypedResults.Ok(new DivisorResponse(newDivisor));\n    }\n}\n"
}
